title: DIVINE BENEFIT
subtitle: Daily Benefits Devotional Guide
author: Bishop (Evang) Roseline Matthew

memory_verse.text: And a certain woman, which had an issue of blood twelve years.

divine_benefits: There is hope for you, no matter what you are passing through now.
That situation will not destroy you, but create the gate way for a major testimony in your life.
entries.condition: Take deliberate steps of faith towards God with all your heart and trust Him enough to obey His instructions no matter the cost. And at last, he will turn your mourning into a lasting joy.
entries.prayer: Lord, help me to take deliberate steps of faith towards you with all my heart and teach me to obey your instructions no matter the cost from this day in Jesus name.
entries.prophetic_words: Your story will surely change for the best as you hold unto God by faith. You will surely stand out for the work of change He has started in your life from this day in Jesus name.
entries.daily_bible_study: DAILY BIBLE STUDY: MORNING: MARK 7 EVENING: JUDGES 5-6

memory_verse.text: And had suffered many things of many physicians and had spent all that she had, and was nothing bettered, but rather grew worse

divine_benefits: No matter what you have passed through, there is good news for you.
Jesus is passing through your route to settle your case in any area you really need Him.
entries.condition: Turn the case to the Lord with strong prayer of faith, and with your heart ready to obey every divine instructions without any distraction and surely heaven will respond positively to your case.
entries.prayer: Lord teach me to turn my case to you with the prayer of faith with my heart ready to obey every divine instructions from this day in Jesus name.
entries.prophetic_words: Your prayer of faith will never be turn down by God. You are in your days of lasting Solution and your life will be a living proof that God answers prayers from this day in Jesus name.
entries.daily_bible_study: DAILY BIBLE STUDY: MORNING: MARK 8 EVENING: JUDGES 7-8

memory_verse.text: When she had heard of Jesus, came in the press behind, and touched his garment

divine_benefits: The news of victory is coming your way.
The grace to take the steps that leads to success and joy in life is on you.
entries.condition: Put aside every obstacle and press forward by faith towards God with all your heart, with all you are, and with all you have, and then you will definitely see yourself in the land of miracles.
entries.prayer: Lord, I receive grace to put aside every obstacle and truly press by faith towards you until my need is met from this day in Jesus name.
entries.prophetic_words: Receive grace to take the right steps at the right time of your miracle and many shall hear and see the wonders of God over your life from this day in Jesus name.
entries.daily_bible_study: DAILY BIBLE STUDY: MORNING: MARK 9:1-29 EVENING: JUDGES 9

memory_verse.text: For she said, if I may touch but His clothes I shall be whole.

divine_benefits: Heaven is ready to respond to you when you call
The Lord shall heal every part that needed healing in your life and you shall be completely whole.
entries.condition: Lift up your eyes by faith towards the Lord, and take steps that is in line with His word, don't be discourage neither be distracted from Him until you handle your result and truly you will be a testimony to your world that God is faithful.
entries.prayer: Lord, teach me to lift up my eyes by faith towards you without getting discouraged or distracted from you until I handle my results from this day in Jesus name.
entries.prophetic_words: Your life shall begin to command divine results that will compel many to serve the Lord from this day in Jesus name.
entries.daily_bible_study: DAILY BIBLE STUDY: MORNING: MARK 9:30-50 EVENING: JUDGES 10-12

memory_verse.text: And straightway the fountain of her blood was dried up; and she felt in her body that she was healed of that plague.

divine_benefits: The power from above will come on you and dry up every fountain of problems the enemies has brought into your life.
Every plague around your life has been destroyed by the Lord.
entries.condition: It is your steps of faith towards God that really move Him into doing wonders, if you really want to enjoy His wondrous works, make real steps of faith towards Him and you shall smile at last.
entries.prayer: Lord, help me to make steps of faith towards you so that I can enjoy your wonders in my life from this day in Jesus name.
entries.prophetic_words: You are reborn in Christ to produce great results, no power will stop you from this day in Jesus name.
entries.daily_bible_study: DAILY BIBLE STUDY: MORNING: MARK 10:1-31 EVENING: JUDGES 13-14

memory_verse.text: And Jesus, immediately knowing in himself that virtue had gone out of him, turned him about in the press, and said, who touched my clothes?

divine_benefits: Heaven will recognize your touch of faith and respond to you without delay.
Your faith will compel heaven to release your miracle to the surprise of men.
entries.condition: Make up your mind to take unusual steps (that is not against God's word) towards the kingdom that will compel heaven to stand up on your behalf until you become what He has destined you to be on earth and in the world to come you will not also loose out.
entries.prayer: Lord, teach me to deliberately take unusual steps that is in line with your word until I am fulfilled to your glory from this day in Jesus name.
entries.prophetic_words: The plan and the purpose of God for your life will surely stand. You are created to stand out and to be a praise to God on earth, receive grace to enjoy divine arrangement for your life in Jesus name.
entries.daily_bible_study: DAILY BIBLE STUDY: MORNING: MARK 10:32-52 EVENING: JUDGES 15-17

memory_verse.text: And his disciples said unto him, thou seest the multitude thronging thee, and sayest thou, who touched me?

divine_benefits: God will release unexpected miracle into your life that will cause embarrassment in the midst of men.
Your faith will compel heaven to do some strange miracles that will command attraction on every side.
entries.condition: Recognize divine opportunities and grab them without delay, that could be the very time you have been waiting for. It is your responds of faith to divine opportunities that create a large room for miracles and testimonies. Be wise and be vigilant enough to recognize them, and you will be the wisest among others.
entries.prayer: Lord, help me to be at alert spiritually to recognize divine opportunities so that I can grab them without delay from this day in Jesus name.
entries.prophetic_words: It is your turn to be the next goodnews your world will begin to spread and many shall hear and celebrate with you from this day in name.
entries.daily_bible_study: DAILY BIBLE STUDY: MORNING: MARK 11 EVENING: JUDGES 18-19

memory_verse.text: And he looked round about to see her that had done this thing.

divine_benefits: Heaven will look on you with the eyes of favour.
Divine favour shall differentiate and raise you above your equals.
entries.condition: Be brave and push off every obstacle to your faith in God and match forward with your sincere service to Him, and your service of faith shall speak for you at the right time.
entries.prayer: Lord, give me a brave heart to push off every obstacle to my faith in you so that I can constantly render sincere service to you until it will speak for me in your presence from this day in Jesus name.
entries.prophetic_words: Your faith in God is bringing you to the front in life where many will see and be challenged to serve God with all sincerity and faithfulness from this day in Jesus name.
entries.daily_bible_study: DAILY BIBLE STUDY: MORNING: MARK 12 EVENING: JUDGES 20-21

memory_verse.text: But the woman fearing and trembling knowing what was done in her, came and fell down before Him, and told him all the truth.

divine_benefits: Your miracle shall not be hidden
The Lord will do a work in your life that will command His fear in your heart.
The miracle of God in your life shall cause you to tell the truth about Jesus to your world.
entries.condition: Don't be too familiar with God, rather let His fear occupy your heart to the level it will drive away every manner of evil and compel you to do what is right in His sight without minding any distraction, and He will be delighted to mind you until He brings you to the top in the journey of life.
entries.prayer: Lord, create your fear in my heart to the level your word will be a command in my heart from this day in Jesus name.
entries.prophetic_words: God is taken you from the valley of depression to the mountain of honour and testimonies from this day in Jesus name
entries.daily_bible_study: DAILY BIBLE STUDY: MORNING: MARK 13 EVENING: RUTH 1-2

memory_verse.text: And he said unto her, Daughter, thy faith hath made thee whole; go in peace, and be whole of thy plague.

divine_benefits: Your faith will command unusual breakthrough in your life
You are surrounded with divine peace that passeth all understanding.
Every plague in your life are over.
entries.condition: The prayer of faith to God can never be over emphasized because that is the power destroy forces of impossibilities and hand over to you divine package for destiny. Choose that way and you will be known as a celebrant.
entries.prayer: Lord, teach me to pray the prayer of faith that will command great results into my life from this day in Jesus name.
entries.prophetic_words: Your life shall be a living proof that God is alive and you will be a sign post through which many will submit to the Lordship of Jesus from this day in Jesus name..

memory_verse.text: That they would desire mercies of the God of heaven concerning this secret; that Daniel and his fellows should not perish with the rest of the wise men of Babylon

divine_benefits: The God of heaven shall surely show you mercy in the journey of life.
God will show to you the secret that will connect you to your destiny.
God is your covering, you will never be destroyed by the destroyers.
entries.condition: Be addicted to God in love, and let nothing move you more than Him, let your eyes be constantly fix on Him in any situation you find yourself. The closer you are to Him, the brighter life becomes, choose to be closer to Him and your life shall begin to command great results.
entries.prayer: Lord, teach me to be addicted to you in love that nothing move me than you, so that I can constantly fix my eyes on you and be closer to you from this day in Jesus name.
entries.prophetic_words: God will raise you above every destruction and hand over to you the package of destiny and Through you many others will be save from this day in Jesus name
entries.daily_bible_study: DAILY BIBLE STUDY: MORNING: MARK 15 EVENING: 1 CHRONICLES 2-3

memory_verse.text: Then was the secret revealed unto Daniel in a night vision, then Daniel blessed the God of heaven.

divine_benefits: God will hand over to you the secret to get to the top in life.
Divine wisdom shall make you stand out above others.
God shall give you many reasons to bless His great name.
entries.condition: Learn to seek the face of God in prayers. Stop complain, stop murmuring, stop blaming people for your failure, take the responsibilities to turn it over to the Lord in prayers, God does not turn down the prayer of faith to Him and so, He will not turn you down like men do, God can be trusted if you can seek Him sincerely.
entries.prayer: s, God does not turn down the prayer of faith to Him and so, He will not turn you down like men do, God can be trusted if you can seek Him sincerely. PRAYER: Lord, teach me to seek your face in prayer, remove every spirit of complaining and murmuring from me and help me to trust you with all my heart till my change will come from this day in Jesus name.
entries.prophetic_words: Heaven shall not hide from you the secret of success in life. You shall handle success very cheap because you carry God's presence from this day in Jesus name.
entries.daily_bible_study: DAILY BIBLE STUDY: MORNING: MARK 16 EVENING: 1 CHRONICLES 4-5

memory_verse.text: Daniel answered and said, blessed be the name of God for ever and ever for wisdom and might are his.

divine_benefits: Your life shall constantly be a praise to the Almighty God.
Wisdom to make it in life is in the hands of God and you belong to Him.
You belong to the God who has all power to overcome every manner of obstacle in life.
entries.condition: Know it, that whatever you are and whatever you shall be is from the Lord, therefore, learn to give Him all the glory for each victory and success you handle so that He can be delighted to do more.
entries.prayer: Lord, teach me to give you all the glory for each victory and success I handle in life, I know all is from you from this day in Jesus name.
entries.prophetic_words: You cannot fall and you cannot fail for God who create and owns power and wisdom is standing by your side for success in the journey of life from this day in Jesus name.
entries.daily_bible_study: DAILY BIBLE STUDY: MORNING: HEBREWS 1-2 EVENING: 1 CHRONICLES 6

memory_verse.text: And he changeth the times and the seasons; he removeth kings, and setteth up kings; he giveth wisdom unto the wise, and knowledge to them that know understanding.

divine_benefits: God is the controller of every events of the world, therefore, your destiny is secured in Him.
God shall overthrow all your opposers and enthrone you to rule over them.
God shall grant you the wisdom that will make you wiser than all your enemies.
entries.condition: Serve God with openness of heart and be ready to stand your ground and trust Him no matter the cost and you shall be a living proof of His power and wisdom to your world.
entries.prayer: Lord, help me to serve you with openness of heart and teach me to stand my ground to truly trust you no matter the cost from this day in Jesus name.
entries.prophetic_words: Your openness to God will open the doors of victory and honour into your life from this day in Jesus name.
entries.daily_bible_study: DAILY BIBLE STUDY: MORNING: HEBREWS 3-4 EVENING: 1 CHRONICLES 7-8

memory_verse.text: He revealeth the deep and secret things; he knoweth what is in the darkness and the light dwelleth with him.

divine_benefits: God shall show to you the mysteries of life to your understanding.
God's wisdom shall raise you to the platform of glory and honour, beyond human understanding.
entries.condition: The secret of life is with God, if you must make it in life, you must make Him your first priority and make His instructions your body guard that is the shortcut to the life of comfort and success in the journey of life; If you don't want life to walk against you, choose that way.
entries.prayer: Lord, help me to make you my first priority and your instructions my body guard, I don't want life to walk against me from this day in Jesus name.
entries.prophetic_words: The secret of life shall be divinely handed over to you and you shall enjoy life and Success very cheap from this day in Jesus name.
entries.daily_bible_study: DAILY BIBLE STUDY: MORNING: HEBREWS 5-6 EVENING: 1 CHRONICLES 9

memory_verse.text: I thank thee, and praise thee, o thou God of my fathers, who hast given me wisdom and might and hast made known unto me now what we desired of thee; for thou hast now made known unto us the kings matter.

divine_benefits: The Lord will give you the wisdom you need to manage every situation that comes your way.
The Lord has giving you health and strength to enjoy in the journey of life.
God will show you the part way to destiny with great understanding.
entries.condition: It is your response to God with the heart of appreciation that makes Him do more for you. Understand that He is the giver of every victory you handie, and learn to return all the glory to Him with a humble spirit.
entries.prayer: Lord, teach me to return all the glory to you for each victory I handle with a humble spirit from this day in Jesus name.
entries.prophetic_words: The Lord shall raise you above human expression, and you will become an amazement to your world from this day in Jesus name
entries.daily_bible_study: DAILY BIBLE STUDY: MORNING: HEBREWS 7-8 EVENING: 1 SAMUEL 1-2

memory_verse.text: Then the king Nebuchadnezzar fell upon his face, and worshipped Daniel, and commanded that they should offer an oblation and sweet odour unto him.

divine_benefits: The Lord will make you a bundle of surprise to your generation.
The Lord will compel important personality to honour you greatly.
entries.condition: Make yourself available in God's hands so that He can use you to rescue those that the enemies has destined to destroy in hell. The more He uses you, the more He reveal His ways to you; and the more you understand Him, the more of His revelation you enjoy and the more He compel men to honour you.
entries.prayer: Lord, I receive grace from you to be available to you in service with great delight from this day in Jesus name.
entries.prophetic_words: You carry God's presence, and His presence in your life will cause men to bow before you and compel them to serve your God with great fear from this day in Jesus name.
entries.daily_bible_study: DAILY BIBLE STUDY: MORNING: HEBREWS 9 EVENING: 1 SAMUEL 3-5

memory_verse.text: The king answered unto Daniel, and said, of a truth it is, that your God is a God of gods, and a Lord of kings and a revealer of secrets, SEEING THOU couldest reveal this secret.

divine_benefits: The Lord will do a thing in your life that will cause fear in the heart of men.
The God you serve is above every other gods, therefore, He will raise you above your fellows.
The Lord will give you wisdom to interpret the mysteries of life to the understanding of men.
entries.condition: Learn to be submissive to God in every thing. turn every situation that comes your way to God in prayers, and be ready to trust Him without any reason to doubt, and He will make you a surprise package to your world.
entries.prayer: Lord, teach me to be submissive to you in all things, to the level I will turn every situation to you in prayers without any doubt from this day in Jesus name.
entries.prophetic_words: God will show up in your case to the level no one will have any reason to doubt Him from this day in Jesus name.
entries.daily_bible_study: DAILY BIBLE STUDY: MORNING: HEBREWS 10 EVENING: 1 SAMUEL 6-8

memory_verse.text: Then the king made Daniel a great man, and gave him any great gifts and made him ruler over the whole rovince of Babylon, and chief of the governors over the wise men of Babylon.

divine_benefits: The Lord will connect you supernaturally to those that will connect you to the top in life. The Lord has ordained your promotion and men has no choice than to co-operate. Your life shall be clothed with great favour that will attract valuable gifts.
entries.condition: Let God and His instructions be your ad controller in all you do and be addicted to His ways thou permitting any distraction of any kind and He will delighted to make you a ruler in life.
entries.prayer: Lord, help me to be controlled by you and Sour instructions to the level will be so addicted to our ways without any distraction from this day in Jesus name.
entries.prophetic_words: The Lord shall make you great And you shall be a great commander in the affairs of men this day in Jesus.name..
entries.daily_bible_study: DAILY BIBLE STUDY: MORNING: HEBREWS 11 EVENING: 1 SAMUEL 9-11

memory_verse.text: This I say then, walk in the spirit, and ye shall not fulfil the lust of the flesh.

divine_benefits: The Holy Spirit will tell you what to do at the right time.
The Holy Spirit will show you the way out of trouble.
entries.condition: Learn to obey and submit totally to the leading of the Holy Spirit; the assurance of lasting victory and success are tied to His leadings if you can just submit to Him with great delight, you will be led to the land of fulfillment.
entries.prayer: Lord, help me to submit to the leading of your spirit with great delight from this day in Jesus name.
entries.prophetic_words: The Holy Spirit is your ordained helper and guide, He will lead you to the streams of joy that will never get dried from this day in Jesus name
entries.daily_bible_study: DAILY BIBLE STUDY: MORNING: HEBREWS 12-13 EVENING: 1 SAMUEL 12-13

memory_verse.text: For the flesh lusteth against the spirit, and the spirit against the flesh, and these are contrary the one to the other; so that ye cannot do the things that ye would.

divine_benefits: The Holy Spirit will help you to detect what is right so that you will not be a victim in life.
The Holy Spirit will teach you to please God, so that the law of life can please you.
entries.condition: Until you learn to obey and truly co-operate with the spirit of God to walk in God's way and die to selfish desires, the law of life cannot co-operate to release your full blessings that will take you to fulfillment. The shortcut to the life of comfort is to submit to the great comforter (the Holy Spirit)
entries.prayer: Lord, help me to obey and truly co-operate with your spirit to walk in your ways to the level, I will die to every selfish desire from this day in Jesus name.
entries.prophetic_words: As you submit to the Holy Spirit, heaven shall submit what belong to you until you become a praise to God from this day in Jesus name
entries.daily_bible_study: DAILY BIBLE STUDY: MORNING: JAMES 1-2 EVENING: 1 SAMUEL 14

memory_verse.text: But if ye be led of the spirit, ye are not under the law.

divine_benefits: The Holy Spirit will make life easy and comfortable for you.
He will guide you into all truth you need to know about God and life.
entries.condition: Allow the Holy Spirit to guide you, don't be stiff in His hands, be flexible to His instructions no matter the cost and He will be delighted to show you the way to a successful life.
entries.prayer: Lord, help me to allow your spirit to guide me, I don't know the way, you alone knows the way to the life of comfort and joy, teach me to be flexible to you through your spirit from this day in Jesus name.
entries.prophetic_words: As you accept the guidance of the Holy Spirit. He will not let you fall and He will not let you fail from this day in Jesus name.
entries.daily_bible_study: DAILY BIBLE STUDY: MORNING: JAMES 3-4 EVENING: 1 SAMUEL 15-16

memory_verse.text: But the fruit of the spirit is love, joy, peace, longsuffering, gentleness, goodness, faith.

divine_benefits: You shall be productive through the power of the Holy Spirit.
Your life shall begin to produce love, lasting joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness and faithfulness.
entries.condition: If only you can give the Holy Spirit a chance to take full control of your heart and your life, He will surely bring the best out of you. He does not force people to submit to Him, it is a choice you need to make. Remember that the choice you make today has great effect to your destiny, choose to give Him a chance and you will be glad that you did.
entries.prayer: Lord, I willingly submit to your spirit to have His way in my life, teach me not to argue with Him in any way from this day in Jesus name.
entries.prophetic_words: Your life shall be surrounded with God's goodness and your fruits shall be so attractive to your world that men shall run under you for fulfillment from this day in Jesus name.
entries.daily_bible_study: DAILY BIBLE STUDY: MORNING: JAMES 5 EVENING: 1 SAMUEL 17-18

memory_verse.text: Meekness, temperance against such there is no law.

divine_benefits: Your fruits shall be so great and attractive through the Holy Spirit.
The spirit of God in you shall begin to produce gentleness and self-control and you shall be a blessing to your world.
entries.condition: Your submission to the Holy Spirit can never be over emphasized because that is the part way to the life of peace and lasting joy, don't ignore Him, if you don't want peace and joy to ignore you in life.
entries.prayer: Lord, teach me to truly follow the leading of your Holy Spirit without any doubt in my heart from this day in Jesus name.
entries.prophetic_words: You will never be led astray, the spirit of God in you shall take you into the world of wonders and you shall in-turn become a of peace to your generation from this day in Jesus name.
entries.daily_bible_study: DAILY BIBLE STUDY: MORNING: 1 PETER 1 EVENING: 1 SAMUEL 19-20

memory_verse.text: And they that are Christ's have crucified the flesh with the affections and lusts.

divine_benefits: You belong to Christ, therefore the devil cannot tamper with your destiny.
entries.condition: If you say you really belong to Jesus then allow His spirit to help you destroy every evil desire that is in your heart, He is the only one that has the power to handle them and flush them out of your spiritual system and give you the power to live for God and appreciate what Jesus did for you on the cross, give the Holy Spirit a chance in your life.
entries.prayer: Lord, I belong to you, help me to submit to your spirit to help me kill every evil desire in me and teach me to live my life for you alone from this day in Jesus name.
entries.prophetic_words: You are no more under the control of satan, you are now under the control of Jesus, where honour and comfort flow in Jesus name.
entries.daily_bible_study: DAILY BIBLE STUDY: MORNING: 1 PETER 2-3 EVENING: 1 SAMUEL 21-23

memory_verse.text: Let us not be desirous of vain glory, provoking one another, envying one another.

divine_benefits: As you follow the leading of the Holy Spirit, you will not need to look for honour, it will naturally cloth you like garment.
entries.condition: From now decide to live by the power of the Holy Spirit alone by following His leadership sincerely in every part of life. Then you won't need to look for honours and popularity which lead to jealousy and bad feelings, rather trust Him and continue to follow Him sincerely, you will notice that all this things will be added very cheap to your life.
entries.prayer: Lord, help me to truly decide to depend on the leadership of your spirit by following every instructions He gives from this day in Jesus name.
entries.prophetic_words: As you follow the Holy Spirit. What people look for with their life and could not handle shall come to you very cheap to the level you will become a mystery in the eyes of men from this day in Jesus name.
entries.daily_bible_study: DAILY BIBLE STUDY: MORNING: 1 PETER 4-5 EVENING: 1 SAMUEL 24-25

memory_verse.text: That he would grant you, according to the riches of his glory, to be strengthened with might by his spirit in the inner man.

divine_benefits: Out of God's glorious and unlimited resources, He will give all you need to reach your destination in life.
The Holy Spirit will make you become a strong follower of Christ so that you can enjoy His benefits.
entries.condition: Decide strongly in your heart to become an addicted follower of Jesus, then depend on the Holy Spirit to help you, because you cannot do it yourself, but if you can learn of Him, He will surely take you across every hindrance and you shall be known as a victor in life.
entries.prayer: Lord, help me to decide strongly to be your sincere follower through the help of the Holy Spirit from this day in Jesus name.
entries.prophetic_words: The Holy Spirit will make you fly above every obstacle that leads to failure until you see yourself in the land of glory from this day in Jesus name.
entries.daily_bible_study: DAILY BIBLE STUDY: MORNING: 2 PETER 1 EVENING: 1 SAMUEL 26-28

memory_verse.text: That Christ may dwell in your heart by faith; that ye, being rooted and grounded in love.

divine_benefits: Christ is living in you, therefore you cannot fail.
He will stand by you to succeed in life to His glory.
entries.condition: Make your heart neat enough for Christ to dwell in you, He cannot dwell in an unclean heart, cast away whatever is not clean and walk with Him by faith, and stand firm and be deeply rooted in His love and you shall find out that there is great benefits in Christ.
entries.prayer: Lord, help me to make my heart a neat place for you to dwell and follow you by faith without distraction from this day in Jesus.
entries.prophetic_words: Jesus is the foundation of your life and destiny, you cannot sink and you cannot crumple from this day in Jesus name.
entries.daily_bible_study: DAILY BIBLE STUDY: MORNING: 2 PETER 2-3 EVENING: 1 SAMUEL 29-31

memory_verse.text: And so know the love of Christ, which passeth knowledge, that ye might be filled with all the fullness of God.

divine_benefits: The love of God is so great upon your life and it has no end.
Through your life many will experience the love of Christ.
entries.condition: Desire to know more about Christ by reading and meditating on His word through the help of the Holy Spirit until your life will be filled with all that God is and your life shall begin to produce great evidence that God is great for many to embrace His love in your generation
entries.prayer: Lord, create in me a strong desire to know you better to the level I will be addicted to reading and meditating on your word through the help of the Holy Spirit from this day in Jesus name.
entries.prophetic_words: You are now an evidence of God's love to your world and through you many shall be attracted to Him from this day in Jesus name.
entries.daily_bible_study: DAILY BIBLE STUDY: MORNING: 1 JOHN 1 EVENING: PSALMS 1-7

memory_verse.text: Abundantly above all that we ask or think, according to the power that worketh in us.

divine_benefits: The Lord will do more than you can dear ask or even dream beyond your highest prayers, or desire or thought or even hope.
The power of God in you will make it happen.
entries.condition: Recognize that it is God that has all the power to make anything happen, therefore, give Him glory at any level you find yourself genuinely from your heart and He will gladly continue to do more.
entries.prayer: Lord, teach me to genuinely give you all the glory at any level I find myself from this day in Jesus name.
entries.prophetic_words: Your life is divinely loaded with abundance by God therefore, nothing can reduce you from this day in Jesus name.
entries.daily_bible_study: DAILY BIBLE STUDY: MORNING: 1 JOHN 2 EVENING: PSALMS 8-13

memory_verse.text: And Jesus when he was baptized, went up straightway out of the water; and lothe heavens were opened unto him, and he saw the spirit of God descending like a dove, and lighting upon him.

divine_benefits: Heaven will surprise you with unexpected package.
The spirit of God will rest upon you with the message of good news.
Your eyes shall see the package God has release into your life.
entries.condition: Be open to God in service and in obedient. Make up your mind to practice God's word, let His instructions make meaning in your heart to the level it will take control of you, without doubt, your life shall become a wonder to your world.
